If you live in Gaia, for routine manipulations I can recommend this clinic and Dr. Joao

He really has an approach to cats, when even in the Montenegrin hospital (considered the best or one of the best in the country) we were told that without sedation they could not take blood from the cat. In Joao he was always calm and allowed to take blood, and with anemia we donated blood often. And he did it quickly, confidently and comfortably for the cat. The nurses there are also top. They kiss the cat, muito fofu, etc. Even when the cat was in very bad condition, we
We went to Joao for tests. He is also attentive and positive, upon request he writes everything in English by mail, you can also communicate with the clinic on WhatsApp.

We have another clinic near our house, but we took the cat by taxi to Joao. Because in that clinic the cat screamed wildly during the blood test and the owners were not allowed into the room.
